project_type_details: Expo SDK 55 app using React Native 0.83.10, React 19.2, Expo Router, local native capture/history modules, SQLCipher, and a Cloudflare Worker relay. Native iOS project exists; Android is generated through Expo prebuild. Web production export is a marketing site; QA mode exports the ledger.

startup_commands.context: Start Expo Metro server; default port 8081.

build_commands.context: expo run:ios; build and run the native development app.
expo run:android; generates native Android project when absent.
Clear Metro cache, export static web output, finalize SEO HTML. Production origin supplied through EXPO_PUBLIC_WAFRA_SITE_URL.
Cloud simulator development build when explicitly desired.

argent_workflow.notes: Load argent-react-native-app-workflow and device-interact skills before app interaction. Prefer an already running target from list-devices. Expo Go does not cover the custom native modules or SQLCipher configuration. No devices were inspected or operated by this subagent.

env_resolution.strategy: Expo EXPO_PUBLIC environment variables plus EAS build profile environment settings and EAS environment selection.
env_resolution.notes: No .env files were found by the workspace snapshot. EAS development/preview builds enable founder unlock and selected research flags; production disables them. app.json contains empty RevenueCat/legal/support extra fields, so production readiness must be checked against resolved environment and release gates rather than inferred from static config.

terminal_tools.expo_cli: Project-local CLI through npx expo; no global Expo CLI version detected.
terminal_tools.eas_cli: Global EAS CLI 21.7.0 is installed; project pins EAS CLI 22.4.0. Use the pinned npx version for EAS workflows.

unit_tests.notes: Custom transpile-and-Node runner enforces 67 declared app suites, 3 server suites, and 2 native Swift suites on macOS. Includes parser corpus, monetary invariants, permissions, setup UX, native contracts, Kotlin regex, Worker, and release checks. Requires sqlite3 and a working Java compiler for full verification. Runner serializes shared test build output where flock or lockf is available.

e2e_tests.notes: Web E2E runner exports with EXPO_PUBLIC_WAFRA_E2E_DEMO=1, clears isolated Metro cache, serves with scripts/e2e/serve.mjs on port 8126, and runs smoke, period, persistence, and navigation suites. Native adversarial onboarding/permissions/RTL flows are in scripts/e2e/adversarial and .maestro. Swift behavior tests exist for live capture; the project's native test scripts provide the authoritative invocation.

feedback_loop_tools.notes: Argent MCP tools are available. No custom Metro or Babel configuration was detected. React Compiler is enabled through Expo experiments.

quality_control.ci_gate: Root typecheck, lint, Expo iOS prebuild for native contract fixtures, npm test, relay typecheck/tests/dry-run, plus separate Playwright job. Native iOS job is path-filtered and runs native-history-store.sh after prebuild/pods.
documentation_gaps: scripts/e2e/README.md still describes three browser suites and a Python server; run.sh currently runs four suites with the repository server and an explicit QA environment flag.
Adversarial native README includes older Xcode 26.1 instructions while current CI explicitly requires Xcode 26.2 or newer.

CI native path filter and macOS job explicitly cover the history bridge; root macOS npm test also executes the live capture bridge. Review whether live-capture changes should trigger equivalent CI native build coverage.

additional_notes: Repository instructions require versioned Expo SDK 55 documentation before Expo/RN code changes, preserve existing changes, and prohibit commits/pushes without explicit user authorization. This was a read-only inspection with no dependency installation, tests, builds, app launches, or device actions. Financial/parser availability is distinct from worldwide manual/storefront support; README documents UAE corpus support and local/supplemental capture paths.
